evidence.author: Step
evidence.used: low pale gravel-grey and sand-tan earth mounds of varied size scattered over stony sand, sparse scrub, no trees, low wall and houses far behind
site identity and extent (530 x 305 m archaeological site, shown as a 120 x 80 m portion of the field)

review.gaps: Tower removed, far houses capped at 3 m, 14 extra heaps in dark sand-tan and grey-white plus dark scrub tufts; camera frames the whole field so mounds look small and flat, heaps are faceted with no gravel texture, ground stays pale grey-beige (no darker ground plate possible without breaking the camera fit).
